`app/src/main/java/io/mo/glassmic/root/AudioPolicyMain.java`:

```java
package io.mo.glassmic.root;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Process;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;

/**
 * Standalone app_process entry point. Uses only framework/Java classes, never the Application/Hilt.
 * The parent owns stdin: EOF or a missing heartbeat terminates this process and its Binder policy.
 * Arguments: comma-separated target app UIDs, FIFO path. All UIDs share one injection mix.
 * PCM FIFO protocol: big-endian int64 discontinuity epoch, int32 length, PCM16 LE mono 48 kHz.
 */
public final class AudioPolicyMain {
    private static volatile long lastHeartbeat = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
    private static volatile Context context;
    private static volatile Class<?> policyClass;
    private static volatile Object policy;
    private static volatile AudioTrack track;
    private static final AtomicBoolean exiting = new AtomicBoolean();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (Process.myUid() != 0 || args.length != 2) {
            System.out.println("ERROR Root access and target UIDs are required");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        // Start BEFORE registration: a parent disappearing during startup must also be handled.
        new Thread(() -> {
            try (BufferedReader input = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in))) {
                String line;
                while ((line = input.readLine()) != null) {
                    if ("STOP".equals(line)) break;
                    if ("PING".equals(line)) lastHeartbeat = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            exit(0);
        }, "glassmic-owner").start();
        new Thread(() -> {
            while (true) {
                SystemClock.sleep(1000);
                if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - lastHeartbeat > 6000) exit(2);
            }
        }, "glassmic-lease").start();
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(AudioPolicyMain::cleanup));
        try {
            int[] uids = parseUids(args[0]);
            Looper.prepareMainLooper();
            // Hidden framework APIs are used only in this explicitly root-launched process.
            Class<?> vm = Class.forName("dalvik.system.VMRuntime");
            Object runtime = vm.getDeclaredMethod("getRuntime").invoke(null);
            vm.getDeclaredMethod("setHiddenApiExemptions", String[].class)
                    .invoke(runtime, (Object) new String[]{"L"});
            Class<?> activityThread = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread");
            Object thread = activityThread.getMethod("systemMain").invoke(null);
            context = (Context) activityThread.getMethod("getSystemContext").invoke(thread);
            register(uids);
            new Thread(() -> {
                try {
                    pump(args[1]);
                    exit(0);
                } catch (Throwable error) {
                    fail(error);
                }
            }, "glassmic-policy-pcm").start();
            System.out.println("READY");
            System.out.flush();
            Looper.loop();
        } catch (Throwable error) {
            fail(error);
        }
    }

    private static int[] parseUids(String arg) {
        String[] parts = arg.split(",");
        int[] uids = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            uids[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i].trim());
            if (uids[i] % 100000 < 10000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("System UIDs are not supported");
        }
        if (uids.length == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("No target UID");
        return uids;
    }

    private static void register(int[] uids) throws Exception {
        Class<?> ruleClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioMixingRule");
        Class<?> ruleBuilderClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioMixingRule$Builder");
        Class<?> mixClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioMix");
        Class<?> mixBuilderClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioMix$Builder");
        policyClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioPolicy");
        Class<?> builderClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioPolicy$Builder");
        Object ruleBuilder = ruleBuilderClass.getConstructor().newInstance();
        try {
            ruleBuilderClass.getMethod("setTargetMixRole", int.class).invoke(ruleBuilder,
                    constant(ruleClass, "MIX_ROLE_INJECTOR"));
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException | NoSuchFieldException olderAndroid) {
            ruleBuilderClass.getMethod("setTargetMixType", int.class).invoke(ruleBuilder,
                    constant(mixClass, "MIX_TYPE_RECORDERS"));
        }
        // Criteria of the same type are OR-ed: the mix captures a recorder whose UID matches any target.
        Method addMixRule = ruleBuilderClass.getMethod("addMixRule", int.class, Object.class);
        int matchUid = constant(ruleClass, "RULE_MATCH_UID");
        for (int uid : uids) addMixRule.invoke(ruleBuilder, matchUid, uid);
        Object rule = ruleBuilderClass.getMethod("build").invoke(ruleBuilder);
        Object mixBuilder = mixBuilderClass.getConstructor(ruleClass).newInstance(rule);
        AudioFormat format = new AudioFormat.Builder().setSampleRate(48000)
                .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT).build();
        mixBuilderClass.getMethod("setFormat", AudioFormat.class).invoke(mixBuilder, format);
        mixBuilderClass.getMethod("setRouteFlags", int.class).invoke(mixBuilder,
                constant(mixClass, "ROUTE_FLAG_LOOP_BACK"));
        Object mix = mixBuilderClass.getMethod("build").invoke(mixBuilder);
        Object builder = builderClass.getConstructor(Context.class).newInstance(context);
        builderClass.getMethod("addMix", mixClass).invoke(builder, mix);
        Object candidate = builderClass.getMethod("build").invoke(builder);
        int result;
        try {
            Method method = AudioManager.class.getDeclaredMethod("registerAudioPolicyStatic", policyClass);
            method.setAccessible(true);
            result = (Integer) method.invoke(null, candidate);
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException olderAndroid) {
            result = (Integer) AudioManager.class.getMethod("registerAudioPolicy", policyClass)
                    .invoke(context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE), candidate);
        }
        if (result != 0) throw new IllegalStateException("AudioPolicy registration failed: " + result);
        policy = candidate;
        track = (AudioTrack) policyClass.getMethod("createAudioTrackSource", mixClass).invoke(policy, mix);
        if (track == null || track.getState() != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Injection AudioTrack is unavailable");
        }
        track.setBufferSizeInFrames(4800); // Bound stale audio to about 100 ms where supported.
        track.play();
    }

    private static void pump(String fifo) throws Exception {
        Process.setThreadPriority(Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_AUDIO);
        long epoch = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        byte[] pcm = new byte[16384];
        try (DataInputStream input = new DataInputStream(new FileInputStream(fifo))) {
            while (true) {
                long nextEpoch = input.readLong();
                int size = input.readInt();
                if (size <= 0 || size > pcm.length || (size & 1) != 0) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid PCM frame size: " + size);
                }
                input.readFully(pcm, 0, size);
                if (nextEpoch != epoch) {
                    track.pause();
                    track.flush();
                    track.play();
                    epoch = nextEpoch;
                }
                int offset = 0;
                long deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 60;
                while (offset < size) {
                    int written = track.write(pcm, offset, size - offset, AudioTrack.WRITE_NON_BLOCKING);
                    if (written < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("AudioTrack.write: " + written);
                    offset += written;
                    if (offset == size) break;
                    if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() >= deadline) {
                        // No recording client / stalled route: do not build an unbounded backlog.
                        track.pause();
                        track.flush();
                        track.play();
                        break;
                    }
                    SystemClock.sleep(2);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static int constant(Class<?> type, String name) throws Exception {
        java.lang.reflect.Field field = type.getDeclaredField(name);
        field.setAccessible(true);
        return field.getInt(null);
    }

    private static void cleanup() {
        if (track != null) {
            try { track.stop(); } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
            try { track.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
        }
        if (policy != null) {
            try {
                AudioManager.class.getMethod("unregisterAudioPolicy", policyClass)
                        .invoke(context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE), policy);
            } catch (Throwable error) {
                try {
                    Method method = AudioManager.class.getDeclaredMethod("unregisterAudioPolicyAsyncStatic", policyClass);
                    method.setAccessible(true);
                    method.invoke(null, policy);
                } catch (Throwable ignored) { /* Binder death also removes the registered policy. */ }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void fail(Throwable error) {
        while (error instanceof InvocationTargetException && error.getCause() != null) error = error.getCause();
        System.out.println("ERROR " + error);
        System.out.flush();
        exit(1);
    }

    private static void exit(int code) {
        if (!exiting.compareAndSet(false, true)) return;
        // A vendor AudioTrack release / Binder unregister must not strand a root process.
        new Thread(() -> {
            SystemClock.sleep(1500);
            Process.killProcess(Process.myPid());
        }, "glassmic-exit-deadline").start();
        System.exit(code);
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/io/mo/glassmic/root/LiveCaptureController.kt`:

```kt
package io.mo.glassmic.root

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.system.ErrnoException
import android.system.Os
import android.system.OsConstants
import android.system.StructPollfd
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import io.mo.glassmic.audio.LiveCaptureSource
import io.mo.glassmic.log.GlassLog
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.TimeoutCancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelAndJoin
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileDescriptor
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

enum class LivePhase { IDLE, STARTING, ACTIVE, ERROR }

/** 应用显示名；取不到时退回包名。 */
fun Context.appLabelOf(packageName: String): String {
    if (packageName.isBlank()) return "—"
    return runCatching {
        packageManager.getApplicationLabel(packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)).toString()
    }.getOrDefault(packageName)
}

data class LiveStatus(
    val phase: LivePhase = LivePhase.IDLE,
    val packageName: String = "",
    val detail: String = ""
)

/**
 * 实时 App 音频（issue #42）的 root 抓取会话。
 *
 * [open] 启动 [PlaybackCaptureMain]（root app_process），把它写进私有 FIFO 的 PCM 推给返回的
 * [LiveCaptureSource]；音源被 Publisher 换掉时 [LiveCaptureSource.release] 回调到这里结束会话。
 * 同一时间只保留一个会话。
 */
@Singleton
class LiveCaptureController @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) {
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
    private val mutex = Mutex()
    private val mutableStatus = MutableStateFlow(LiveStatus())
    val status: StateFlow<LiveStatus> = mutableStatus.asStateFlow()

    // 用户选好的音源 App。音频库页和悬浮窗共用，悬浮窗「开始实时」直接用它。
    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val mutableSelected = MutableStateFlow(prefs.getString(KEY_PACKAGE, "").orEmpty())
    val selectedPackage: StateFlow<String> = mutableSelected.asStateFlow()

    fun selectPackage(packageName: String) {
        mutableSelected.value = packageName
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_PACKAGE, packageName).apply()
    }

    private var session: Session? = null // 仅在持有 mutex 时访问

    private class Session(
        val process: Process,
        val fifo: File,
        val fd: FileDescriptor,
        val source: LiveCaptureSource
    ) {
        val ready = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
        var reader: Job? = null
        var heartbeat: Job? = null
        var pump: Thread? = null
        @Volatile var closed = false
        @Volatile var error: String? = null
    }

    /** 当前会话的抓取统计，供诊断使用。 */
    fun stats(): String? {
        val src = session?.source ?: return null
        return "pkg=${src.packageName} pushed=${src.pushedBytes.get()} dropped=${src.droppedBytes.get()} " +
            "underruns=${src.underruns.get()} buffered=${src.bufferedMs}ms"
    }

    /** 开始抓取 [packageName] 的播放声音；失败抛异常并把状态置为 ERROR。 */
    suspend fun open(packageName: String, render: Boolean = true): LiveCaptureSource = mutex.withLock {
        closeLocked()
        publish(LivePhase.STARTING, packageName)
        try {
            val app = context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
            require(app.uid % 100000 >= 10000 && app.uid != android.os.Process.myUid()) {
                "不支持抓取系统进程或 GlassMic 自身"
            }
            if (app.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_INSTALLED == 0) throw IOException("应用未安装")
            val opened = start(app.uid, render, packageName)
            session = opened
            withTimeout(START_TIMEOUT_MS) { opened.ready.await() }
            startPump(opened)
            publish(LivePhase.ACTIVE, packageName)
            GlassLog.b("LiveCapture") { "已开始抓取 $packageName uid=${app.uid} render=$render" }
            opened.source
        } catch (error: Throwable) {
            closeLocked()
            val message = when (error) {
                is TimeoutCancellationException -> "root 抓取进程启动超时"
                else -> error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName
            }
            publish(LivePhase.ERROR, packageName, message)
            GlassLog.b("LiveCapture") { "启动失败 $packageName: $message" }
            throw IOException(message, error)
        }
    }

    /** 主动结束（例如用户点停止）。音源被替换时也会经 release 回调走到这里。 */
    suspend fun close() = mutex.withLock {
        closeLocked()
        publish(LivePhase.IDLE)
    }

    private fun onSourceReleased(source: LiveCaptureSource) {
        scope.launch {
            mutex.withLock {
                if (session?.source === source) {
                    closeLocked()
                    publish(LivePhase.IDLE)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun start(uid: Int, render: Boolean, packageName: String): Session {
        val dir = File(context.filesDir, "live-capture").apply { mkdirs() }
        dir.listFiles()?.forEach { it.delete() } // 上次异常退出残留的 FIFO
        val fifo = File(dir, "pcm-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
        Os.mkfifo(fifo.absolutePath, 0x180 /* 0600 */)
        // 先以非阻塞方式打开读端：root 端随后以阻塞方式打开写端时不会卡住
        val fd = try {
            Os.open(fifo.absolutePath, OsConstants.O_RDONLY or OsConstants.O_NONBLOCK, 0)
        } catch (error: ErrnoException) {
            fifo.delete(); throw error
        }
        val command = "CLASSPATH=${quote(context.applicationInfo.sourceDir)} exec /system/bin/app_process " +
            "/system/bin io.mo.glassmic.root.PlaybackCaptureMain $uid ${if (render) 1 else 0} ${quote(fifo.absolutePath)}"
        val process = try {
            ProcessBuilder("su", "-c", command).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            runCatching { Os.close(fd) }
            fifo.delete()
            throw error
        }
        val current = Session(process, fifo, fd, LiveCaptureSource(packageName, ::onSourceReleased))
        current.heartbeat = scope.launch {
            try {
                while (isActive && process.isAlive) {
                    process.outputStream.write("PING\n".toByteArray())
                    process.outputStream.flush()
                    delay(1000)
                }
            } catch (error: IOException) { current.error = error.message }
        }
        current.reader = scope.launch {
            val line = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            val bytes = ByteArray(1024)
            try {
                val input = process.inputStream
                while (isActive && (process.isAlive || input.available() > 0)) {
                    val count = input.available().coerceAtMost(bytes.size)
                    if (count == 0) { delay(25); continue }
                    val n = input.read(bytes, 0, count)
                    if (n < 0) break
                    for (i in 0 until n) {
                        if (bytes[i] == 10.toByte()) {
                            val text = line.toString("UTF-8").trim()
                            line.reset()
                            when {
                                text == "READY" -> current.ready.complete(Unit)
                                text.startsWith("ERROR ") -> {
                                    current.error = text.removePrefix("ERROR ").take(500)
                                    current.ready.completeExceptionally(IOException(current.error))
                                }
                                text.isNotEmpty() -> GlassLog.b("LiveCapture") { "helper: ${text.take(200)}" }
                            }
                        } else if (line.size() < 2048) line.write(bytes[i].toInt())
                    }
                }
                if (!current.ready.isCompleted) current.ready.completeExceptionally(
                    IOException("root 抓取进程已退出（未授权 root？）"))
            } catch (error: IOException) {
                current.error = error.message
                current.ready.completeExceptionally(error)
            }
            // 进程在运行中途退出：反映到状态上，音源继续输出静音
            if (!current.closed) {
                publish(LivePhase.ERROR, current.source.packageName, current.error ?: "root 抓取进程已退出")
            }
        }
        return current
    }

    /** 专用线程：poll FIFO，把 PCM 推进环形缓冲。 */
    private fun startPump(current: Session) {
        current.pump = Thread({
            runCatching { android.os.Process.setThreadPriority(android.os.Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_URGENT_AUDIO) }
            val buf = ByteArray(4096)
            val pfd = StructPollfd().apply { fd = current.fd; events = OsConstants.POLLIN.toShort() }
            var carry = -1 // 奇数字节时暂存，保证推进去的始终是完整 16 位样本
            while (!current.closed) {
                try {
                    if (Os.poll(arrayOf(pfd), 200) <= 0) continue
                    val n = Os.read(current.fd, buf, 1, buf.size - 1)
                    if (n == 0) { Thread.sleep(20); continue } // 写端尚未打开或已关闭
                    var start = 1
                    var len = n
                    if (carry >= 0) { buf[0] = carry.toByte(); start = 0; len++ ; carry = -1 }
                    if (len % 2 != 0) { carry = buf[start + len - 1].toInt() and 0xFF; len-- }
                    if (len > 0) {
                        if (start == 1) System.arraycopy(buf, 1, buf, 0, len)
                        current.source.push(buf, len)
                    }
                } catch (error: ErrnoException) {
                    if (error.errno == OsConstants.EAGAIN || error.errno == OsConstants.EINTR) continue
                    current.error = error.message
                    break
                } catch (_: InterruptedException) {
                    break
                }
            }
        }, "glassmic-live-pump").apply { isDaemon = true; start() }
    }

    private suspend fun closeLocked() = withContext(NonCancellable) {
        val current = session ?: return@withContext
        session = null
        current.closed = true
        current.heartbeat?.cancelAndJoin()
        // 关闭 owner 通道 → root 进程退出并注销 AudioPolicy
        runCatching { current.process.outputStream.close() }
        current.pump?.join(500)
        runCatching { Os.close(current.fd) }
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            if (!current.process.waitFor(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) current.process.destroyForcibly()
        }
        current.reader?.cancelAndJoin()
        runCatching { current.process.inputStream.close() }
        current.fifo.delete()
        GlassLog.b("LiveCapture") { "已结束抓取 ${current.source.packageName}" }
    }

    private fun publish(phase: LivePhase, packageName: String = "", detail: String = "") {
        mutableStatus.value = LiveStatus(phase, packageName, detail)
    }

    private fun quote(value: String) = "'" + value.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'"

    private companion object {
        const val START_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000L
        // 沿用旧版音频库页的存储位置，升级后选择不丢
        const val PREFS_NAME = "live_capture"
        const val KEY_PACKAGE = "package"
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/io/mo/glassmic/root/PlaybackCaptureMain.java`:

```java
package io.mo.glassmic.root;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.media.AudioRecord;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Process;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;

/**
 * Standalone app_process entry point that captures another app's playback (issue #42).
 * Uses only framework/Java classes, never the Application/Hilt.
 *
 * Registers a dynamic AudioPolicy whose loopback mix matches the source app's players by UID,
 * reads it through {@code createAudioRecordSink} and streams raw PCM16 LE mono 48 kHz into a FIFO.
 * A root-registered policy is not subject to the player's allowed-capture policy, and must NOT set
 * {@code allowPrivilegedPlaybackCapture}: that path is capped at 16 kHz.
 *
 * Arguments: source app UID, render flag (1 = keep playing on the device, 0 = divert), FIFO path.
 * Ownership mirrors {@link AudioPolicyMain}: stdin EOF / STOP or a missing PING ends the process.
 */
public final class PlaybackCaptureMain {
    private static final int SAMPLE_RATE = 48000;
    private static final int CHUNK_BYTES = 1920; // 20 ms mono PCM16

    private static volatile long lastHeartbeat = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
    private static volatile Context context;
    private static volatile Class<?> policyClass;
    private static volatile Object policy;
    private static volatile AudioRecord record;
    private static final AtomicBoolean exiting = new AtomicBoolean();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (Process.myUid() != 0 || args.length != 3) {
            System.out.println("ERROR Root access, source UID, render flag and FIFO are required");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        new Thread(() -> {
            try (BufferedReader input = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in))) {
                String line;
                while ((line = input.readLine()) != null) {
                    if ("STOP".equals(line)) break;
                    if ("PING".equals(line)) lastHeartbeat = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            exit(0);
        }, "glassmic-owner").start();
        new Thread(() -> {
            while (true) {
                SystemClock.sleep(1000);
                if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - lastHeartbeat > 6000) exit(2);
            }
        }, "glassmic-lease").start();
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(PlaybackCaptureMain::cleanup));
        try {
            int uid = Integer.parseInt(args[0].trim());
            if (uid % 100000 < 10000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("System UIDs are not supported");
            boolean render = "1".equals(args[1]);
            Looper.prepareMainLooper();
            Class<?> vm = Class.forName("dalvik.system.VMRuntime");
            Object runtime = vm.getDeclaredMethod("getRuntime").invoke(null);
            vm.getDeclaredMethod("setHiddenApiExemptions", String[].class)
                    .invoke(runtime, (Object) new String[]{"L"});
            Class<?> activityThread = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread");
            Object thread = activityThread.getMethod("systemMain").invoke(null);
            context = (Context) activityThread.getMethod("getSystemContext").invoke(thread);
            register(uid, render);
            new Thread(() -> {
                try {
                    pump(args[2]);
                    exit(0);
                } catch (Throwable error) {
                    fail(error);
                }
            }, "glassmic-capture-pcm").start();
            System.out.println("READY");
            System.out.flush();
            Looper.loop();
        } catch (Throwable error) {
            fail(error);
        }
    }

    private static void register(int uid, boolean render) throws Exception {
        Class<?> ruleClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioMixingRule");
        Class<?> ruleBuilderClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioMixingRule$Builder");
        Class<?> mixClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioMix");
        Class<?> mixBuilderClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioMix$Builder");
        policyClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioPolicy");
        Class<?> builderClass = Class.forName("android.media.audiopolicy.AudioPolicy$Builder");

        Object ruleBuilder = ruleBuilderClass.getConstructor().newInstance();
        try {
            ruleBuilderClass.getMethod("setTargetMixRole", int.class).invoke(ruleBuilder,
                    constant(ruleClass, "MIX_ROLE_PLAYERS"));
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException | NoSuchFieldException olderAndroid) {
            ruleBuilderClass.getMethod("setTargetMixType", int.class).invoke(ruleBuilder,
                    constant(mixClass, "MIX_TYPE_PLAYERS"));
        }
        ruleBuilderClass.getMethod("addMixRule", int.class, Object.class).invoke(ruleBuilder,
                constant(ruleClass, "RULE_MATCH_UID"), uid);
        Object rule = ruleBuilderClass.getMethod("build").invoke(ruleBuilder);

        // The mix format uses an OUTPUT channel mask; the record sink converts it to the input mask.
        AudioFormat format = new AudioFormat.Builder().setSampleRate(SAMPLE_RATE)
                .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT).build();
        Object mixBuilder = mixBuilderClass.getConstructor(ruleClass).newInstance(rule);
        mixBuilderClass.getMethod("setFormat", AudioFormat.class).invoke(mixBuilder, format);
        int flags = constant(mixClass, "ROUTE_FLAG_LOOP_BACK");
        if (render) flags |= constant(mixClass, "ROUTE_FLAG_RENDER");
        mixBuilderClass.getMethod("setRouteFlags", int.class).invoke(mixBuilder, flags);
        Object mix = mixBuilderClass.getMethod("build").invoke(mixBuilder);

        Object builder = builderClass.getConstructor(Context.class).newInstance(context);
        builderClass.getMethod("addMix", mixClass).invoke(builder, mix);
        Object candidate = builderClass.getMethod("build").invoke(builder);
        int result;
        try {
            Method method = AudioManager.class.getDeclaredMethod("registerAudioPolicyStatic", policyClass);
            method.setAccessible(true);
            result = (Integer) method.invoke(null, candidate);
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException olderAndroid) {
            result = (Integer) AudioManager.class.getMethod("registerAudioPolicy", policyClass)
                    .invoke(context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE), candidate);
        }
        if (result != 0) throw new IllegalStateException("AudioPolicy registration failed: " + result);
        policy = candidate;
        record = (AudioRecord) policyClass.getMethod("createAudioRecordSink", mixClass).invoke(policy, mix);
        if (record == null || record.getState() != AudioRecord.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Capture AudioRecord is unavailable");
        }
        if (record.getSampleRate() != SAMPLE_RATE || record.getChannelCount() != 1) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unexpected capture format " + record.getSampleRate()
                    + "Hz x" + record.getChannelCount());
        }
        record.startRecording();
        if (record.getRecordingState() != AudioRecord.RECORDSTATE_RECORDING) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Capture did not start");
        }
    }

    private static void pump(String fifo) throws Exception {
        Process.setThreadPriority(Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_AUDIO);
        byte[] pcm = new byte[CHUNK_BYTES];
        // The parent opened the read end before launching us, so this open does not block.
        try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(fifo)) {
            while (true) {
                int n = record.read(pcm, 0, pcm.length);
                if (n < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("AudioRecord.read: " + n);
                if (n > 0) out.write(pcm, 0, n); // EPIPE once the parent closes its end.
            }
        }
    }

    private static int constant(Class<?> type, String name) throws Exception {
        java.lang.reflect.Field field = type.getDeclaredField(name);
        field.setAccessible(true);
        return field.getInt(null);
    }

    private static void cleanup() {
        if (record != null) {
            try { record.stop(); } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
            try { record.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
        }
        if (policy != null) {
            try {
                AudioManager.class.getMethod("unregisterAudioPolicy", policyClass)
                        .invoke(context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE), policy);
            } catch (Throwable error) {
                try {
                    Method method = AudioManager.class.getDeclaredMethod("unregisterAudioPolicyAsyncStatic", policyClass);
                    method.setAccessible(true);
                    method.invoke(null, policy);
                } catch (Throwable ignored) { /* Binder death also removes the registered policy. */ }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void fail(Throwable error) {
        while (error instanceof InvocationTargetException && error.getCause() != null) error = error.getCause();
        System.out.println("ERROR " + error);
        System.out.flush();
        exit(1);
    }

    private static void exit(int code) {
        if (!exiting.compareAndSet(false, true)) return;
        new Thread(() -> {
            SystemClock.sleep(1500);
            Process.killProcess(Process.myPid());
        }, "glassmic-exit-deadline").start();
        System.exit(code);
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/io/mo/glassmic/service/BootReceiver.kt`:

```kt
package io.mo.glassmic.service

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint
import io.mo.glassmic.data.runtime.BootGateRepository
import io.mo.glassmic.log.GlassLog
import javax.inject.Inject

/**
 * 启动广播。
 *
 * 注意：本接收器**不会**自动启动 ForegroundService、不会恢复运行态。
 * 它的唯一职责是刷新 BootGate 的 boot_id，确保设备重启后默认关闭。
 *
 * 这是和需求 §3.2 严格对齐的——不实现"开机自启虚拟麦克风"。
 */
@AndroidEntryPoint
class BootReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {

    @Inject lateinit var bootGate: BootGateRepository

    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        val action = intent.action ?: return
        if (action != Intent.ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED &&
            action != Intent.ACTION_LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED) return

        bootGate.refreshBootId()
        // 新 boot_id 与旧的不一致 => userEnabledAfterBoot() 自动返回 false
        GlassLog.b("Boot") { "设备启动完成，BootGate 已重置，虚拟麦克风默认关闭" }
    }
}
```

```kt
// ============ 悬浮窗数据模型（不直接暴露 Room 实体）============

/**
 * 悬浮窗形态。MINI_BAR 为旧版迷你播放条，重设计后并入音频库面板，仅为兼容保留枚举值。
 */
enum class FloatMode { BALL, MINI_BAR, MENU, TTS, TTS_SETTINGS }

data class FloatGroupItem(val id: String, val emoji: String, val name: String)
data class FloatClipItem(val id: String, val name: String, val isCurrent: Boolean, val durationMs: Long = 0L)

/** 实时应用音频快捷入口（issue #46）：在音频库页选好的音源 App 及当前抓取状态。 */
data class FloatLiveItem(val packageName: String, val label: String, val running: Boolean, val starting: Boolean)

/** 展开态面板的默认宽度（设计稿 390 宽屏幕左右各留 14）。窄屏按可用宽度收缩。 */
const val EXPANDED_PANEL_WIDTH_DP = 340
val EXPANDED_PANEL_WIDTH: Dp = EXPANDED_PANEL_WIDTH_DP.dp

private enum class PanelTab { LIBRARY, TTS }

/**
 * 悬浮窗根 UI：悬浮球 / 主面板（音频库 · 文字转语音）/ 文字转语音设置。
 * 所有位置/窗口管理由 Service 处理，这里只负责渲染与回调。
 */
@Composable
fun FloatingBubbleRoot(
    mode: FloatMode,
    panelMaxWidth: Dp,
    panelMaxHeight: Dp,
    activeFile: Boolean,
    paused: Boolean,
    isStreaming: Boolean = false,
    audioMonitorEnabled: Boolean = false,
    onToggleAudioMonitor: () -> Unit = {},
    outputGain: Float = OutputGain.DEFAULT,
    onSetOutputGain: (Float) -> Unit = {},
    playbackPolicy: PlaybackPolicy = PlaybackPolicy.SILENCE,
    onSetPlaybackPolicy: (PlaybackPolicy) -> Unit = {},
    positionMs: Long,
    durationMs: Long,
    currentName: String?,
    currentGroupId: String? = null,
    sizeDp: Dp,
    iconPath: String?,
    opacity: Float,
    groups: List<FloatGroupItem>,
    clipsProvider: (String) -> Flow<List<FloatClipItem>>,
    onBallTap: () -> Unit,
    onTogglePause: () -> Unit,
    onSeek: (Float) -> Unit,
    onOpenMenu: () -> Unit,
    onCollapse: () -> Unit,
    onSelectClip: (String) -> Unit,
    onOpenTts: () -> Unit,
    ttsGenerating: Boolean,
    ttsReady: Boolean,
    ttsFailed: Boolean,
    ttsPreviewing: Boolean = false,
    onGenerateTts: (String) -> Unit,
    onTogglePreviewTts: () -> Unit = {},
    onPlayTts: () -> Unit,
    ttsProgressBarEnabled: Boolean,
    ttsActive: Boolean,
    onOpenTtsSettings: () -> Unit,
    onToggleTtsProgressBar: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    ttsDelayMs: Int,
    onSetTtsDelay: (Int) -> Unit,
    ttsDelayRemainingMs: Long,
    onCancelDelayedTts: () -> Unit,
    onSeekTts: (Float) -> Unit,
    onCloseTtsSettings: () -> Unit,
    onDragBy: (Float, Float) -> Unit,
    onDragEnd: () -> Unit,
    panelWidthDp: Int = 0,
    panelHeightDp: Int = 0,
    onResizePanel: (widthDp: Int, heightDp: Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
    fishMode: Boolean = false,
    fishVoices: List<Pair<String, String>> = emptyList(),
    fishVoiceId: String = "",
    onSelectFishVoice: (String) -> Unit = {},
    fishEnhance: Boolean = false,
    onToggleFishEnhance: (Boolean) -> Unit = {},
    ttsProgressLines: List<String> = emptyList(),
    ttsEnhanced: TtsProgress.Enhanced? = null,
    live: FloatLiveItem? = null,
    onToggleLive: () -> Unit = {},
) {
    // 面板尺寸：拖动中实时变化，松手后经 onResizePanel 存进配置。
    // 对象只创建一次——拖动手势在 pointerInput(Unit) 里常驻，若配置一变就换新对象，
    // 手势仍握着旧对象，第二次拖动改的就是界面不再显示的那个（表现为"松手后再拖拖不动"）。
    // 配置值变化（保存后回读、恢复默认）只同步数值。
    val panelSize = remember { PanelSize(panelWidthDp.takeIf { it > 0 }?.dp, panelHeightDp.takeIf { it > 0 }?.dp) }
    LaunchedEffect(panelWidthDp, panelHeightDp) {
        panelSize.width = panelWidthDp.takeIf { it > 0 }?.dp
        panelSize.height = panelHeightDp.takeIf { it > 0 }?.dp
    }
    val saveSize = {
        onResizePanel(panelSize.width?.value?.roundToInt() ?: 0, panelSize.height?.value?.roundToInt() ?: 0)
    }
    val resetSize = { onResizePanel(0, 0) }

    // 精简 / 最小档的播放控制：有正在播的音源（文件或 TTS）就暂停 / 继续；
    // 否则若文字转语音已生成好，点一下开始播放
    val canToggle = activeFile || ttsActive
    val miniEnabled = canToggle || ttsReady
    val miniPlaying = canToggle && !paused
    val miniToggle: () -> Unit = { if (canToggle) onTogglePause() else if (ttsReady) onPlayTts() }
    val compactContent: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit = {
        PlaybackRow(
            enabled = miniEnabled,
            paused = !miniPlaying,
            currentName = currentName,
            positionMs = positionMs,
            durationMs = durationMs,
            onTogglePause = miniToggle,
            onSeek = if (ttsActive) onSeekTts else onSeek
        )
    }
    val miniContent: @Composable BoxScope.(Dp) -> Unit = { side -> MiniPlayButton(miniEnabled, miniPlaying, side) }
    // TTS 草稿提到这一层：切 tab 会重建下方内容，草稿放在 TtsTab 内部会被清空。
    var ttsDraft by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    // 自动标签完成后把带标签的文本回填到输入框（仅当输入框仍是送去优化的那段原文），
    // 用户能看到加了哪些标签，再次生成时也会跳过 LLM 直接合成
    LaunchedEffect(ttsEnhanced) {
        val e = ttsEnhanced ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        if (ttsDraft.trim() == e.original.trim()) ttsDraft = e.tagged
    }
    // 音频库当前查看的分组，同理提到这一层；默认跟随当前音源所在分组。
    var browsingGroupId by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    CompositionLocalProvider(LocalContentColor provides glass.ink) {
        when (mode) {
            FloatMode.BALL -> Ball(
                sizeDp = sizeDp,
                iconPath = iconPath,
                opacity = opacity,
                streaming = isStreaming && !paused,
                onTap = onBallTap,
                onDragBy = onDragBy,
                onDragEnd = onDragEnd
            )

            FloatMode.MINI_BAR, FloatMode.MENU, FloatMode.TTS -> {
                val tab = if (mode == FloatMode.TTS) PanelTab.TTS else PanelTab.LIBRARY
                val availableHeight = minOf(panelSize.height ?: panelMaxHeight, panelMaxHeight - PANEL_SHADOW_MARGIN * 2)
                val compactLibrary = tab == PanelTab.LIBRARY &&
                    availableHeight < LIBRARY_COMPACT_HEIGHT * LocalDensity.current.fontScale
                PanelShell(
                    maxWidth = panelMaxWidth,
                    maxHeight = if (tab == PanelTab.TTS) Dp.Infinity else panelMaxHeight,
                    panel = panelSize,
                    scrollable = tab == PanelTab.TTS,
                    dense = compactLibrary,
                    onResizeEnd = saveSize,
                    onResetSize = resetSize,
                    onDragBy = onDragBy,
                    onDragEnd = onDragEnd,
                    compact = compactContent,
                    mini = miniContent,
                    onMiniTap = miniToggle,
                    onMiniLongPress = onCollapse,
                    header = {
                        Dot(if (isStreaming) glass.err else glass.ink3)
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                        Text(
                            stringResource(
                                when {
                                    !(activeFile || ttsActive) -> R.string.float_streaming_idle
                                    paused -> R.string.home_paused
                                    isStreaming -> R.string.float_streaming_live
                                    else -> R.string.float_streaming_idle
                                }
                            ),
                            fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                        )
                        if (tab == PanelTab.TTS) {
                            CircleIconButton(Icons.Rounded.Tune, stringResource(R.string.float_settings), onOpenTtsSettings)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                        }
                        CollapsePill(onCollapse)
                    }
                ) {
                    Segmented(
                        options = listOf(
                            PanelTab.LIBRARY to stringResource(R.string.float_tab_library),
                            PanelTab.TTS to stringResource(R.string.float_tab_tts)
                        ),
                        selected = tab,
                        onSelect = { if (it == PanelTab.TTS) onOpenTts() else onOpenMenu() },
                        height = 36.dp
                    )
                    if (!compactLibrary) VolumeRow(gain = outputGain, onSetGain = onSetOutputGain)
                    if (tab == PanelTab.LIBRARY) {
                        LibraryTab(
                            compactLayout = compactLibrary,
                            outputGain = outputGain,
                            onSetOutputGain = onSetOutputGain,
                            fixedHeight = panelSize.height != null,
                            activeFile = activeFile,
                            paused = paused,
                            currentName = currentName,
                            positionMs = positionMs,
                            durationMs = durationMs,
                            onTogglePause = onTogglePause,
                            onSeek = onSeek,
                            groups = groups,
                            browsingGroupId = (browsingGroupId ?: currentGroupId)
                                ?.takeIf { id -> groups.any { it.id == id } } ?: groups.firstOrNull()?.id,
                            onBrowseGroup = { browsingGroupId = it },
                            clipsProvider = clipsProvider,
                            onSelectClip = onSelectClip,
                            playbackPolicy = playbackPolicy,
                            onSetPlaybackPolicy = onSetPlaybackPolicy,
                            live = live,
                            onToggleLive = onToggleLive
                        )
                    } else {
                        TtsTab(
                            text = ttsDraft,
                            onTextChange = { ttsDraft = it },
                            generating = ttsGenerating,
                            ready = ttsReady,
                            failed = ttsFailed,
                            previewing = ttsPreviewing,
                            onGenerate = onGenerateTts,
                            onPreview = onTogglePreviewTts,
                            onPlay = onPlayTts,
                            isStreaming = isStreaming,
                            audioMonitorEnabled = audioMonitorEnabled,
                            onToggleAudioMonitor = onToggleAudioMonitor,
                            progressBarEnabled = ttsProgressBarEnabled,
                            ttsActive = ttsActive,
                            positionMs = positionMs,
                            durationMs = durationMs,
                            onSeek = onSeekTts,
                            delayRemainingMs = ttsDelayRemainingMs,
                            onCancelDelayed = onCancelDelayedTts,
                            fishMode = fishMode,
                            fishVoices = fishVoices,
                            fishVoiceId = fishVoiceId,
                            onSelectFishVoice = onSelectFishVoice,
                            fishEnhance = fishEnhance,
                            onToggleFishEnhance = onToggleFishEnhance,
                            progressLines = ttsProgressLines
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            FloatMode.TTS_SETTINGS -> PanelShell(
                maxWidth = panelMaxWidth,
                maxHeight = Dp.Infinity,
                panel = panelSize,
                scrollable = false,
                onResizeEnd = saveSize,
                onResetSize = resetSize,
                onDragBy = onDragBy,
                onDragEnd = onDragEnd,
                compact = compactContent,
                mini = miniContent,
                onMiniTap = miniToggle,
                onMiniLongPress = onCollapse,
                header = {
                    CircleIconButton(
                        Icons.AutoMirrored.Rounded.ArrowBackIos,
                        stringResource(R.string.float_back),
                        onCloseTtsSettings,
                        iconOffset = 3.dp
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Text(
                        stringResource(R.string.float_tts_settings_title),
                        fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                    )
                    CollapsePill(onCollapse)
                }
            ) {
                TtsSettings(
                    progressBarEnabled = ttsProgressBarEnabled,
                    onToggleProgressBar = onToggleTtsProgressBar,
                    delayMs = ttsDelayMs,
                    onSetDelay = onSetTtsDelay
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

/** 拖动手柄：贴在面板标题栏上，让面板展开时也能整体拖动。 */
private fun Modifier.dragHandle(
    onDragBy: (Float, Float) -> Unit,
    onDragEnd: () -> Unit,
): Modifier = this.pointerInput(Unit) {
    detectDragGestures(onDragEnd = { onDragEnd() }) { change, drag ->
        change.consume()
        onDragBy(drag.x, drag.y)
    }
}

// ============ 面板外壳 ============

/** 展开面板的尺寸；null 表示默认（宽 [EXPANDED_PANEL_WIDTH]、高随内容自适应）。 */
@Stable
private class PanelSize(width: Dp?, height: Dp?) {
    var width by mutableStateOf(width)
    var height by mutableStateOf(height)
}

/** 能缩到的绝对最小尺寸：只剩一个播放键。 */
private val PANEL_MIN_WIDTH = 72.dp
private val PANEL_MIN_HEIGHT = 72.dp
/** 不小于这个尺寸时显示完整面板（标签切换 + 列表 / 文字转语音）。 */
private val FULL_MIN_WIDTH = 260.dp
private val FULL_MIN_HEIGHT = 300.dp
/** 小于这个尺寸时只剩播放键；介于两者之间是精简档（标题行 + 播放头）。 */
private val MINI_MAX_WIDTH = 150.dp
private val MINI_MAX_HEIGHT = 120.dp

// 矮屏优先保留选曲列表；只收紧留白，不缩小歌曲和控制按钮的触摸区域。
private val LIBRARY_COMPACT_HEIGHT = 480.dp
private val PANEL_SHADOW_MARGIN = 10.dp
private val COMPACT_PANEL_PADDING = 12.dp
internal val COMPACT_PANEL_GAP = 8.dp
internal val LIBRARY_TOUCH_HEIGHT = 48.dp
internal val LIBRARY_ITEM_GAP = 2.dp
internal val LIBRARY_ITEM_RADIUS = 14.dp
internal val LIBRARY_ITEM_PADDING = 12.dp

/** 面板随尺寸自动切换的显示档位。 */
private enum class PanelLevel { FULL, COMPACT, MINI }

/**
 * 玻璃面板：30 圆角、sheet 材质（浮在任意 App 之上，用近不透明底保证可读）、
 * 发丝描边与投影；标题栏可拖动。
 *
 * 右边缘 / 下边缘 / 右下角可拖动调整大小（右下角有握把，双击恢复默认），松手后保存。
 * 调过高度后内容区填满面板：[scrollable] 为 true 时内容可滚动，音频库则由列表自身滚动。
 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
private fun PanelShell(
    maxWidth: Dp,
    maxHeight: Dp,
    panel: PanelSize,
    scrollable: Boolean,
    dense: Boolean = false,
    onResizeEnd: () -> Unit,
    onResetSize: () -> Unit,
    onDragBy: (Float, Float) -> Unit,
    onDragEnd: () -> Unit,
    header: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit,
    compact: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit,
    mini: @Composable BoxScope.(side: Dp) -> Unit,
    onMiniTap: () -> Unit,
    onMiniLongPress: () -> Unit,
    content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit,
) {
    val t = glass
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val maxW = (maxWidth - PANEL_SHADOW_MARGIN * 2).coerceAtLeast(PANEL_MIN_WIDTH)
    val maxH = if (maxHeight == Dp.Infinity) null else (maxHeight - PANEL_SHADOW_MARGIN * 2).coerceAtLeast(PANEL_MIN_HEIGHT)
    val width = (panel.width ?: EXPANDED_PANEL_WIDTH).coerceIn(PANEL_MIN_WIDTH, maxW)
    val fixedHeight = panel.height?.let { h -> if (maxH != null) h.coerceIn(PANEL_MIN_HEIGHT, maxH) else h.coerceAtLeast(PANEL_MIN_HEIGHT) }
        ?: if (dense && width >= FULL_MIN_WIDTH) maxH else null
    var measuredHeight by remember { mutableStateOf(0.dp) }
    // 档位依据用户主动设置的高度。旋转导致的屏幕限高不能把选曲入口隐藏。
    val level = when {
        width < MINI_MAX_WIDTH || (panel.height?.let { it < MINI_MAX_HEIGHT } == true) -> PanelLevel.MINI
        width < FULL_MIN_WIDTH || (panel.height?.let { it < FULL_MIN_HEIGHT } == true) -> PanelLevel.COMPACT
        else -> PanelLevel.FULL
    }

    // 拖动手势用 pointerInput(Unit) 常驻，读取最新尺寸要经 rememberUpdatedState
    val curWidth by rememberUpdatedState(width)
    val curHeight by rememberUpdatedState(fixedHeight ?: measuredHeight)
    val curMaxW by rememberUpdatedState(maxW)
    val curMaxH by rememberUpdatedState(maxH)

    fun resizeBy(dx: Dp, dy: Dp) {
        if (dx != 0.dp) panel.width = (curWidth + dx).coerceIn(PANEL_MIN_WIDTH, curMaxW)
        if (dy != 0.dp) {
            val h = curHeight + dy
            panel.height = curMaxH?.let { h.coerceIn(PANEL_MIN_HEIGHT, it) } ?: h.coerceAtLeast(PANEL_MIN_HEIGHT)
        }
    }

    val latestResizeEnd by rememberUpdatedState(onResizeEnd)
    val latestReset by rememberUpdatedState(onResetSize)

    fun Modifier.resizeHandle(horizontal: Boolean, vertical: Boolean): Modifier = pointerInput(Unit) {
        detectDragGestures(
            onDragStart = {
                // 第一次拖动时把默认值落成具体尺寸，之后按增量调整
                if (panel.width == null) panel.width = curWidth
                if (vertical && panel.height == null) panel.height = curHeight
            },
            onDragEnd = { latestResizeEnd() },
            onDragCancel = { latestResizeEnd() }
        ) { change, drag ->
            change.consume()
            resizeBy(if (horizontal) drag.x.toDp() else 0.dp, if (vertical) drag.y.toDp() else 0.dp)
        }
    }

    // 投影画在外层边距里：窗口是 WRAP_CONTENT，投影外溢会被裁掉
    Box(Modifier.padding(PANEL_SHADOW_MARGIN)) {
        if (level == PanelLevel.MINI) {
            // 最小档：整块是播放键——轻点播放/继续，拖动移动位置，长按收起成悬浮球
            val boxHeight = fixedHeight ?: width
            val side = minOf(width, boxHeight)
            val shape = RoundedCornerShape(minOf(30.dp, side / 2))
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(width, boxHeight)
                    .onSizeChanged { measuredHeight = with(density) { it.height.toDp() } }
                    .shadow(16.dp, shape, ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f), spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
                    .clip(shape)
                    .background(t.sheet)
                    .border(BorderStroke(1.dp, t.rim), shape)
                    .dragHandle(onDragBy, onDragEnd)
                    .combinedClickable(
                        interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                        indication = null,
                        onLongClick = onMiniLongPress,
                        onClick = onMiniTap
                    )
            ) { mini(side) }
        } else {
            val shape = RoundedCornerShape(30.dp)
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .width(width)
                    .then(
                        when {
                            fixedHeight != null -> Modifier.height(fixedHeight)
                            maxH != null -> Modifier.heightIn(max = maxH)
                            else -> Modifier
                        }
                    )
                    .onSizeChanged { measuredHeight = with(density) { it.height.toDp() } }
                    .shadow(16.dp, shape, ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f), spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
                    .clip(shape)
                    .background(t.sheet)
                    .border(BorderStroke(1.dp, t.rim), shape)
                    .padding(if (dense) COMPACT_PANEL_PADDING else if (level == PanelLevel.FULL) 16.dp else 12.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (dense) COMPACT_PANEL_GAP else if (level == PanelLevel.FULL) 14.dp else 10.dp)
            ) {
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().dragHandle(onDragBy, onDragEnd),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    content = header
                )
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .then(if (fixedHeight != null) Modifier.weight(1f) else Modifier)
                        .then(
                            if (fixedHeight != null && (scrollable || level == PanelLevel.COMPACT))
                                Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()) else Modifier
                        ),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (dense) COMPACT_PANEL_GAP else 14.dp),
                    content = if (level == PanelLevel.FULL) content else compact
                )
            }
        }

        // 调整大小的触摸区：跨在面板边缘内外各约 9dp（外侧是投影留白，同属本窗口）
        Box(Modifier.matchParentSize()) {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.CenterEnd)
                    .padding(vertical = if (level == PanelLevel.FULL) 44.dp else 22.dp)
                    .width(20.dp)
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .resizeHandle(horizontal = true, vertical = false)
            )
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                    .padding(horizontal = if (level == PanelLevel.FULL) 44.dp else 22.dp)
                    .height(20.dp)
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .resizeHandle(horizontal = false, vertical = true)
            )
            // 右下角握把：可见的两道斜线，双向拖动；双击恢复默认大小
            val grip = t.ink3
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomEnd)
                    .size(if (level == PanelLevel.FULL) 40.dp else 30.dp)
                    .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures(onDoubleTap = { latestReset() }) }
                    .resizeHandle(horizontal = true, vertical = true)
                    .drawBehind {
                        val stroke = 2.dp.toPx()
                        val inset = 18.dp.toPx()
                        val c = Offset(size.width - inset, size.height - inset)
                        val long = if (level == PanelLevel.FULL) 10.dp.toPx() else 7.dp.toPx()
                        for (len in listOf(long, long / 2f)) {
                            drawLine(
                                grip,
                                Offset(c.x - len, c.y),
                                Offset(c.x, c.y - len),
                                strokeWidth = stroke,
                                cap = StrokeCap.Round
                            )
                        }
                    }
            )
        }
    }
}

// ============ 悬浮球 ============

/**
 * 悬浮球：玻璃外圈 + 72% 内核。推流中内核为主色，否则为中性灰；自定义图标铺满内核。
 */
@Composable
private fun Ball(
    sizeDp: Dp,
    iconPath: String?,
    opacity: Float,
    streaming: Boolean,
    onTap: () -> Unit,
    onDragBy: (Float, Float) -> Unit,
    onDragEnd: () -> Unit,
) {
    val t = glass
    val reduceMotion = LocalReduceMotion.current
    val bitmap = remember(iconPath) {
        iconPath?.takeIf { File(it).exists() }
            ?.let { runCatching { BitmapFactory.decodeFile(it)?.asImageBitmap() }.getOrNull() }
    }

    var pressed by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val scale by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (pressed) 0.94f else 1f,
        animationSpec = if (reduceMotion) snap() else tween(120, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
        label = "ballScale"
    )
    val inner = sizeDp * 0.72f
    // 外层留 6dp 给投影，窗口是 WRAP_CONTENT
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .padding(6.dp)
            .size(sizeDp)
            .alpha(opacity.coerceIn(0.2f, 1f))
            .graphicsLayer { scaleX = scale; scaleY = scale }
            .pointerInput(Unit) {
                detectDragGestures(onDragEnd = { onDragEnd() }) { change, drag ->
                    change.consume()
                    onDragBy(drag.x, drag.y)
                }
            }
            .pointerInput(Unit) {
                detectTapGestures(
                    onPress = {
                        pressed = true
                        tryAwaitRelease()
                        pressed = false
                    },
                    onTap = { onTap() }
                )
            }
            .shadow(8.dp, CircleShape, ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f), spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
            .clip(CircleShape)
            .background(t.sheet)
            .background(t.bar)
            .border(BorderStroke(1.dp, t.rim), CircleShape),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(inner)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(if (streaming) t.primary else if (t.isDark) Color(0xFF4A4B52) else Color(0xFF9A9BA2)),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            if (bitmap != null) {
                Image(
                    bitmap = bitmap,
                    contentDescription = null,
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                    modifier = Modifier.size(inner).clip(CircleShape)
                )
            } else {
                Icon(Icons.Rounded.Mic, null, tint = Color.White, modifier = Modifier.size(inner * 0.5f))
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============ 音频库 tab ============

/** 1500 → "1.5"，1000 → "1"：整秒不拖小数尾巴。 */
internal fun formatSeconds(ms: Long): String {
    val seconds = ms / 1000.0
    return if (seconds % 1.0 == 0.0) seconds.toInt().toString() else "%.1f".format(seconds)
}

internal fun formatMs(ms: Long): String {
    val s = (ms / 1000).coerceAtLeast(0)
    return "%02d:%02d".format(s / 60, s % 60)
}
```

```kt
@Composable
internal fun ColumnScope.LibraryTab(
    fixedHeight: Boolean,
    compactLayout: Boolean,
    outputGain: Float,
    onSetOutputGain: (Float) -> Unit,
    activeFile: Boolean,
    paused: Boolean,
    currentName: String?,
    positionMs: Long,
    durationMs: Long,
    onTogglePause: () -> Unit,
    onSeek: (Float) -> Unit,
    groups: List<FloatGroupItem>,
    browsingGroupId: String?,
    onBrowseGroup: (String) -> Unit,
    clipsProvider: (String) -> Flow<List<FloatClipItem>>,
    onSelectClip: (String) -> Unit,
    playbackPolicy: PlaybackPolicy,
    onSetPlaybackPolicy: (PlaybackPolicy) -> Unit,
    live: FloatLiveItem?,
    onToggleLive: () -> Unit,
) {
    val t = glass
    var controlsExpanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val playback: @Composable () -> Unit = {
        PlaybackRow(
            enabled = activeFile,
            paused = paused,
            currentName = currentName,
            positionMs = positionMs,
            durationMs = durationMs,
            onTogglePause = onTogglePause,
            onSeek = onSeek
        )
    }
    val groupSelector: @Composable () -> Unit = {
        if (groups.size > 1) {
            LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                items(groups, key = { it.id }) { g ->
                    val on = g.id == browsingGroupId
                    Text(
                        "${g.emoji} ${g.name}",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        fontWeight = if (on) FontWeight.SemiBold else FontWeight.Normal,
                        color = if (on) t.ink else t.ink2,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                            .background(if (on) t.primarySoft else t.fill)
                            .clickable { onBrowseGroup(g.id) }
                            .heightIn(min = LIBRARY_TOUCH_HEIGHT)
                            .padding(horizontal = LIBRARY_ITEM_PADDING, vertical = LIBRARY_ITEM_PADDING)
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
    val policySelector: @Composable () -> Unit = {
        Segmented(
            options = listOf(
                PlaybackPolicy.SILENCE to stringResource(R.string.float_policy_once),
                PlaybackPolicy.LOOP to stringResource(R.string.float_policy_loop),
                PlaybackPolicy.REAL_MIC to stringResource(R.string.float_policy_real)
            ),
            selected = if (playbackPolicy == PlaybackPolicy.UNRECOGNIZED) PlaybackPolicy.SILENCE else playbackPolicy,
            onSelect = onSetPlaybackPolicy,
            height = 32.dp,
            fontSize = 12.sp
        )
    }
    val clipsFlow = remember(browsingGroupId) {
        browsingGroupId?.let(clipsProvider) ?: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOf(emptyList())
    }
    val clips by clipsFlow.collectAsState(initial = emptyList())
    val emptyMessage = stringResource(
        if (browsingGroupId == null) R.string.float_no_groups else R.string.float_no_clips_in_group
    )

    if (!compactLayout) {
        playback()
        groupSelector()
    }
    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = compactLayout || fixedHeight)
            .then(if (compactLayout || fixedHeight) Modifier else Modifier.heightIn(max = 264.dp)),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(LIBRARY_ITEM_GAP)
    ) {
        if (compactLayout) {
            // 控制区和分组也参与滚动：极矮屏、大字体或展开设置都不能挤掉歌曲。
            item(key = "controls") {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) { playback() }
                    TextButton(onClick = { controlsExpanded = !controlsExpanded }) {
                        Text(stringResource(if (controlsExpanded) R.string.float_hide_controls else R.string.float_show_controls))
                    }
                }
            }
            if (controlsExpanded) {
                item(key = "volume") { VolumeRow(gain = outputGain, onSetGain = onSetOutputGain) }
                item(key = "policy") { policySelector() }
                if (live != null) item(key = "live") { LiveRow(live, onToggleLive) }
            }
            if (groups.size > 1) item(key = "groups") { groupSelector() }
        }
        if (clips.isEmpty()) {
            item(key = "empty") { PanelEmpty(emptyMessage) }
        } else {
            items(clips, key = { "clip:${it.id}" }) { c ->
                Row(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .heightIn(min = LIBRARY_TOUCH_HEIGHT)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(LIBRARY_ITEM_RADIUS))
                        .background(if (c.isCurrent) t.primarySoft else Color.Transparent)
                        .clickable { onSelectClip(c.id) }
                        .padding(horizontal = LIBRARY_ITEM_PADDING, vertical = COMPACT_PANEL_GAP),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Text(
                        c.name,
                        fontSize = 14.sp,
                        fontWeight = if (c.isCurrent) FontWeight.SemiBold else FontWeight.Normal,
                        color = t.ink,
                        maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                    )
                    if (c.durationMs > 0) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(COMPACT_PANEL_GAP))
                        Text(formatMs(c.durationMs), fontSize = 12.sp, color = t.ink3, fontFamily = MonoFamily)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (!compactLayout) {
        policySelector()
        if (live != null) LiveRow(live, onToggleLive)
    }
}

/**
 * 实时应用音频快捷开关：一键把音源切到音频库页选好的 App，或停掉回到真实麦克风。
 * 免得点过语音包后还要回主界面重新「开始实时输入」（issue #46）。
 */
@Composable
private fun LiveRow(live: FloatLiveItem, onToggle: () -> Unit) {
    val t = glass
    Row(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = LIBRARY_TOUCH_HEIGHT),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        AppIcon(live.packageName, size = 26.dp)
        Spacer(Modifier.width(COMPACT_PANEL_GAP))
        Text(
            stringResource(R.string.source_live, live.label),
            fontSize = 13.sp,
            fontWeight = if (live.running) FontWeight.SemiBold else FontWeight.Normal,
            color = if (live.running) t.ink else t.ink2,
            maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.width(COMPACT_PANEL_GAP))
        val enabled = !live.starting
        Text(
            stringResource(
                when {
                    live.starting -> R.string.live_status_starting
                    live.running -> R.string.float_live_stop
                    else -> R.string.float_live_start
                }
            ),
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            color = when {
                !enabled -> t.ink3
                live.running -> t.err
                else -> Color.White
            },
            maxLines = 1,
            modifier = Modifier
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                .background(
                    when {
                        !enabled -> t.fill
                        live.running -> t.err.copy(alpha = 0.14f)
                        else -> t.primary
                    }
                )
                .clickable(enabled = enabled, onClick = onToggle)
                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
        )
    }
}

/** 播放头：播放/暂停 + 名称 + 进度 + 时间。音频库页与精简档面板共用；窄时隐藏时间。 */
@Composable
internal fun PlaybackRow(
    enabled: Boolean,
    paused: Boolean,
    currentName: String?,
    positionMs: Long,
    durationMs: Long,
    onTogglePause: () -> Unit,
    onSeek: (Float) -> Unit,
) {
    val t = glass
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        val showTime = maxWidth >= 200.dp
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .liquidClickable(enabled = enabled, pressed = 0.9f, onClick = onTogglePause)
                    .size(48.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (enabled) t.primary else t.fill),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(
                    if (paused || !enabled) Icons.Rounded.PlayArrow else Icons.Rounded.Pause,
                    null,
                    tint = if (enabled) Color.White else t.ink3,
                    modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
                )
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.width(12.dp))
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                Text(
                    currentName ?: stringResource(R.string.float_no_source),
                    fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                    maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )
                ThinProgress(
                    fraction = if (durationMs > 0) (positionMs.toFloat() / durationMs).coerceIn(0f, 1f) else 0f,
                    onSeek = if (durationMs > 0) onSeek else null
                )
            }
            if (showTime) {
                Spacer(Modifier.width(12.dp))
                Text(formatMs(positionMs), fontSize = 12.sp, color = t.ink3, fontFamily = MonoFamily)
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * 注入音量：导入音频与 TTS 共用，0% - 300%。拖动时每跨过一个 5% 档就写一次配置，
 * 边拖边能听到变化；点右侧百分比恢复 100%。
 */
@Composable
internal fun VolumeRow(gain: Float, onSetGain: (Float) -> Unit) {
    val t = glass
    // 拖动中以本地值为准，避免配置回读的旧值把滑块拽回去
    var dragging by remember { mutableStateOf<Float?>(null) }
    var lastSent by remember { mutableStateOf(gain) }
    val shown = dragging ?: gain
    val percent = (OutputGain.normalize(shown) * 100).roundToInt()
    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
        Icon(
            if (percent == 0) Icons.AutoMirrored.Rounded.VolumeOff else Icons.AutoMirrored.Rounded.VolumeUp,
            stringResource(R.string.float_volume),
            tint = t.ink2,
            modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
        Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            GlassSlider(
                value = shown,
                onValueChange = { v ->
                    dragging = v
                    val n = OutputGain.normalize(v)
                    if (n != lastSent) {
                        lastSent = n
                        onSetGain(n)
                    }
                },
                valueRange = OutputGain.MIN..OutputGain.MAX,
                onValueChangeFinished = { dragging = null }
            )
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
        Text(
            "$percent%",
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            fontFamily = MonoFamily,
            color = if (percent == 100) t.ink3 else t.primaryInk,
            textAlign = TextAlign.End,
            modifier = Modifier
                .width(44.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .clickable {
                    lastSent = OutputGain.DEFAULT
                    onSetGain(OutputGain.DEFAULT)
                }
                .padding(vertical = 4.dp)
        )
    }
}

/** 最小档：只有一个圆形播放键（整块面板都是点击区，由外壳处理点击）。 */
@Composable
internal fun BoxScope.MiniPlayButton(enabled: Boolean, playing: Boolean, panelSide: Dp) {
    val t = glass
    val d = (panelSide - 16.dp).coerceIn(40.dp, 64.dp)
    Box(
        Modifier
            .align(Alignment.Center)
            .size(d)
            .clip(CircleShape)
            .background(if (enabled) t.primary else t.fill),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Icon(
            if (playing) Icons.Rounded.Pause else Icons.Rounded.PlayArrow,
            stringResource(if (playing) R.string.float_pause else R.string.float_play_resume),
            tint = if (enabled) Color.White else t.ink3,
            modifier = Modifier.size(d * 0.46f)
        )
    }
}

/** 4dp 细进度条，可选点按跳转。 */
@Composable
internal fun ThinProgress(fraction: Float, onSeek: ((Float) -> Unit)?) {
    val t = glass
    BoxWithConstraints(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(12.dp)
            .then(
                if (onSeek != null) Modifier.pointerInput(onSeek) {
                    detectTapGestures { o -> onSeek((o.x / size.width).coerceIn(0f, 1f)) }
                } else Modifier
            ),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart
    ) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(4.dp).background(t.fill, RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)))
        Box(Modifier.width(maxWidth * fraction).height(4.dp).background(t.primary, RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)))
    }
}

@Composable
private fun PanelEmpty(text: String) {
    Text(
        text, fontSize = 13.sp, color = glass.ink3, textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 20.dp)
    )
}
```

`app/src/main/java/io/mo/glassmic/service/FloatingOverlayHost.kt`:

```kt
package io.mo.glassmic.service

import android.content.Context
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ComposeView
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ViewCompositionStrategy
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleRegistry
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStore
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStoreOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.setViewTreeLifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistry
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryController
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryOwner
import androidx.savedstate.setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner

/**
 * 让 Compose 能挂到 WindowManager overlay 的最小生命周期宿主。
 *
 * Service 不是 Activity，ComposeView 运行需要一套 ViewTree 上的
 * Lifecycle / ViewModelStore / SavedStateRegistry Owner。这里自建一套并注入 ComposeView，
 * 是"在悬浮窗里跑 Compose"的标准样板。
 *
 * 用法：
 *   val host = FloatingOverlayHost(this).also { it.onCreate() }
 *   host.setContent { ... }
 *   windowManager.addView(host.view, params)
 *   // 销毁：windowManager.removeView(host.view); host.onDestroy()
 */
class FloatingOverlayHost(context: Context) : LifecycleOwner, ViewModelStoreOwner, SavedStateRegistryOwner {

    private val lifecycleRegistry = LifecycleRegistry(this)
    private val store = ViewModelStore()
    private val savedStateController = SavedStateRegistryController.create(this)

    override val lifecycle: Lifecycle get() = lifecycleRegistry
    override val viewModelStore: ViewModelStore get() = store
    override val savedStateRegistry: SavedStateRegistry get() = savedStateController.savedStateRegistry

    val view: ComposeView = ComposeView(context).apply {
        // 随宿主 Lifecycle 销毁而释放 Composition，避免泄漏
        setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
        setViewTreeLifecycleOwner(this@FloatingOverlayHost)
        setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner(this@FloatingOverlayHost)
        setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner(this@FloatingOverlayHost)
    }

    fun setContent(content: @Composable () -> Unit) = view.setContent(content)

    fun onCreate() {
        savedStateController.performAttach()
        savedStateController.performRestore(null)
        lifecycleRegistry.currentState = Lifecycle.State.RESUMED
    }

    fun onDestroy() {
        lifecycleRegistry.currentState = Lifecycle.State.DESTROYED
        store.clear()
    }
}
```
